question: Does Binance information add executable opportunity value beyond identically scaled OKX information?
relationship_to_active_studies: Independent prospective follow-on; never alters or pools the active successor or replication cohorts

calendar.earliest_start: At least two complete UTC days after qualification and immutable enrollment publication, and after 2026-11-23T00:00:00Z
calendar.activation: Not activated. Publish exact dates, collector/instrument/source identities, acceptance rules and holdout gate before the first eligible recording. No retrospective enrollment or outage replacement.

observations.clock: Monotonic software receive timestamps; independently qualified clock diagnostics required; no exchange timestamp substitution
observations.common_eligibility: Both venues have valid received quotes at t and t-100ms, validated quantities and sessions; preserve every grid opportunity and missingness reason

policies.actions: buy if score>=12; sell if score<=-12; otherwise abstain
policies.training: No learned parameters or outcome-driven changes; discovery and validation audit plumbing only

execution.fill_rule: Independent counterfactual taker orders at last received follower BBO at each modeled arrival; depth must suffice; otherwise explicit rejection. Unknown exits stay unavailable, never zero PnL.
execution.spread: Embedded in bid/ask fills, not deducted again
execution.limits: Independent opportunity values, not a financed portfolio return series or calibrated perpetual margin/funding model. Fee assumptions are scenario inputs, not verified account tiers.

primary_estimate: Candidate minus baseline net USDT per jointly eligible grid opportunity, including abstentions as zero and separating unavailable outcomes

inference.method: Paired moving-block bootstrap of two contiguous UTC dates; 5000 repetitions; seed 42; 95% percentile interval
inference.missing_day_rule: Report incomplete coverage and descriptive estimates; primary confirmatory conclusion is inconclusive if minimum date coverage fails. No replacing calendar days.
inference.limitations: Minimum counts are administrative sufficiency gates, not a prospective power guarantee. Dependence beyond two dates and nonstationarity can invalidate nominal coverage; disclose rather than assert calibrated inference.

secondary_checks: L/2 versus L/2 with constant/zero leader
gross price value versus fee savings and turnover
all fixed delays 0,25,50,100,250,500ms and horizons 250,1000,5000ms without winner selection
absolute candidate economics alongside the paired difference
decision_rule: A positive paired difference does not imply a profitable strategy. Require valid eligibility, sufficient coverage, a positive lower interval endpoint and separately positive absolute candidate economics before describing a promising result. No report automatically authorizes deployment. Otherwise label evidence negative or inconclusive as appropriate.
enrollment_blockers: Collector cloud rehearsal does not qualify a dedicated production host
Absolute UTC accuracy and immutable remote readback need evidence
Versioned raw-to-normalized units, instrument metadata and gap/sequence rules must be bound
Existing cash-opportunity replay is not a calibrated perpetual execution engine
Exact future dates and holdout-release rules must be published before collection
Sensitivity and placebo definitions must be fully source-bound before enrollment
